summary: Starter Set Rules 5/5 (byte range 120508–137575) translated: OTHER HAZARDS chapter — Fatigue / Falling / Explosions / Fire (+ FIRE D6 table) / Synthetics (+ ANDROID CRITICAL SYSTEM DAMAGE table) and the 13-row WEAPONS stat table. Built by exact text-node substitution over the English so every tag, class, style and src stayed byte-identical: the tag skeleton of the two files is literally equal (505 tags each) except for the six `id=` attributes I added to headings. No @UUID / [[…]] constructs and no DO-NOT-TRANSLATE register literal occur anywhere in this unit. Terminology follows the lock (lang/cn.json), glossary_alien + RULINGS (破甲 per R2, 通信科技 per R3), and the conventions already set by ST-J02.cn / ST-J03.cn in this same wave: 快速动作/完整动作, PC & NPC kept Latin, 《希望的最后一日》, always a space between Latin and CJK, and the missing die-glyph restored as 成功符号 (ST-J02.cn line 232 handles the identical upstream defect the same way). Register kept plain-rules — no evblockquoteCenter read-aloud text in this chunk; the two evexamplebox tables are rules tables, translated as such.

open_issues: RANGE AND DAMAGE CODES LEFT IN LATIN — needs a controller ruling, not a per-unit choice. The WEAPONS table carries A/M, S/M, A/S, S/L, S/S, A in the RANGE column and 2E / 3E in the DAMAGE column. These are English-initial abbreviations of terms that ARE translated (紧邻距离/近距离/中距离/远距离 are locked in lang/cn.json; explosive = 爆炸), so a Chinese reader cannot decode them — but there is NO legend for them anywhere in the Starter Set, and corerules carries the same codes at scale (I counted >A/M< ×4, >S/M< ×15, >S/L< ×10 in 6-工作区/raw-dumps/corerules.json, also with no legend). Translating them in this one unit would put starterset and corerules in open contradiction, so I kept them byte-exact and am escalating instead. Proposal if you want them translated: A→紧, S→近, M→中, L→远, and 2E/3E→2爆/3爆, applied to BOTH corpora in one pass; the change is a trivial sed on <td class="die"> cells.

UPSTREAM SOURCE DEFECT (not mine to fix, flagging it): the shipped English has `
  • li ou can no longer recover Health.
    • ` — 'li ou' is a corruption of 'You', present in 2-新手包汉化插件/compendium/en/alien-evolved-starterset.alien-evolved-starter-set.json itself, not an artifact of the chunking. I translated the intended meaning (你无法再恢复生命值。). If there is an errata channel to Free League this is one for it.

UPSTREAM SOURCE DEFECT: the base-die success glyph is missing from two sentences in the shipped English — 'roll MOBILITY – each rolled reduces the damage done by 1' and 'For every rolled, you suffer 1 point of damage'. (Same class of defect as ST-J02's 'For every rolled, the supply rating…'.) I restored it in prose as 成功符号, exactly as ST-J02.cn line 232 did for its instance, rather than leaving a hole in the sentence.

SYMBOL NAME NOT UNIFIED: this wave's ST-J02.cn calls the base-die 6 face 成功符号 (and it is the chapter that DEFINES the dice, so it is the reader's first encounter), while lang/cn.json's ALIENRPG.TAH.radiation calls the same face 基础符号 in running text. Same referent, two names. I used 成功符号 for wave-internal consistency. Controller should unify — if 基础符号 wins, this unit needs two edits (坠落 and 火焰 paragraphs) and ST-J02.cn needs one.

LATIN↔CJK SPACING vs GLOSSARY BYTES: I wrote 阿玛特 M41A 脉冲步枪 with spaces, following this wave's hard convention (ST-J02.cn and ST-J03.cn contain zero Latin-adjacent-CJK pairs — always a space). glossary_alien's entry 'M41A Pulse Rifle' → 'M41A脉冲步枪' has no space. One of the two should be normalised; I judged the running-prose convention to outrank the glossary's byte form for a table cell, but it is the controller's call.

WEAPON NAMES ARE A HARD SYNC POINT WITH THE ITEM DOCUMENTS. This table names 6 things that also exist as Items in the pack (Armat M41A Pulse Rifle, M4A3 Service Pistol, Watatsumi DV-303 Bolt Gun, M240 Incinerator Unit, Combat Knife, Fire Axe, Blunt Instrument). Those Item .name fields are T-BILINGUAL per PROJECT.md §3.4, so their Chinese halves MUST equal the strings in this table or the rules table and the item list will disagree on screen. My strings: 阿玛特 M41A 脉冲步枪 / M4A3 制式手枪 / 绵津见 DV-303 气矢枪 / M240 焚烧器 / 战斗刀 / 消防斧 / 钝器. (制式手枪, 气矢枪, 战斗刀, 切割炬, 脉冲步枪, 焚烧器 all come straight from glossary_alien; the rest are the coinages listed in glossary_gaps.)

'MOD.' column header rendered 修正, not the lock's 检定修正 (ALIENRPG.Item.General.FIELDS.rollMod.label, whose English is 'Roll Modifier', not 'MOD.'). No byte-lock obligation is triggered — the English here is the abbreviated form and the cell is a writing-mode:vertical-rl column where two characters read far better than four. Flagging so it is a decision, not a drift.

'Turn' in the android table ('The android loses its next turn') is a COMBAT turn, not the time unit — in this Starter Set the units are Round/Stretch/Shift (ST-J03), so 节 would be wrong here. I used 失去它的下一次出手. ST-J04 and ST-J05 contain many more instances of combat 'turn'; if the controller settles on something other than 出手, this unit has exactly one occurrence to change.
